divergence_justification: Attempt 0004 faithfully reproduces the ARB medication table as far as served FHIR permits. MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod.start/end is absent for 3,179 invalid/incomplete intervals because mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:172-177 emits the period only for complete, non-reversed times; no alternate FHIR element, including authoredOn, preserves those endpoints. Both direct and medication-mix ingredient paths and multiplicity are retained, and timestamps use TIMESTAMP_NTZ. The remaining 2/39,534 conflicts were exhaustively attributed to the endpoint TIMESTAMPTZ cast at mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:43-44, with zero residual. No divergent dependencies exist and the gap does not alter row inclusion, medication grain, grouping, carry-forward, or a derived clinical output.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.

The candidate's direct and mix branches, multiplicity, exact filters, identifier joins, and TIMESTAMP_NTZ parsing are correct; no alternate FHIR path can recover the oracle timestamps. Unkeyed comparison had paired 3,182 only_candidate NULL tuples and 3,182 only_oracle timestamp tuples, with matching schema and row count. divergent_dependencies(arb)=[]; no retry warranted.

reopen_history.reason: Downstream SQL-on-FHIR consumers join derived tables on getResourceKey() resource keys, which the port computes internally but drops at the outermost SELECT. The attempt adds the paired key column beside each MIMIC identifier column (subject_id->patient_key, hadm_id->encounter_key, stay_id->icu_encounter_key, specimen_id->specimen_key). Additive and shape-only: both comparison paths project manifest columns explicitly, so no compared value can change. The MIMIC integer columns are retained as the oracle join keys.
